in_sanskrit.name: Bhausaheb
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of Wealth
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bhausaheb एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Bhausaheb is a compound name derived from two Sanskrit words: Bhau (Bhauma or Bhagavan, meaning 'Lord of the Earth') and Saheb (Swami or Master). The name evokes the image of a powerful and prosperous leader, revered and respected by all.
